title: Women and National Influence

our girls need fathers girls need fathers not lovers and not sugar daddies if you are father act like one don't act a different way when you go out you have daughters too you want your daughters to in Titus 2 God admonish eita admonishes us to prepare the young girls for what they are growing up into and we don't want our young girls to grow up into any old thing I don't want it to happen why
